module: Editor "Forest View" window, intended to list the forest's ForestItemData ("theForest") as buttons sorted by name. The module is largely unfinished: the edit mode activation/deactivation hooks are commented out at export, so the list is never filled and the window stays empty.
notes: Bug: forestItemDataTreeNode calls selectForestItemData, whose definition is entirely commented out; clicking a button would raise an error if the list contained elements.

populateForestItems, onEditorEditModeActivated and onEditorEditModeDeactivated are defined but never called (the exports M.onEditorEditModeActivated/Deactivated are commented out): forestItemsInfo stays empty.

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is activated; empty body.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame by the editor: draws the "Forest View" window with one button per forestItemsInfo entry.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the "forestEditorView" window (220x320).
